description: Pip, a small animatronic teddy in a top hat: an original enemy who scurries at you like a wind-up toy, crouches, and leaps to cling on. His body art is a stand-in until his final sprites are done. He comes with his own "Sandbox: Pip" stage. In game 2.2.3 he also comes to Furry Entertainment Robotics, from its Abby spawners once the basement door is open: from wave 6 once the game's minimum-wave fix is out (wave 5 is always the Animatronic Spotlight wave), from wave 1 on 2.2.3 itself.
